keyPoints.en: Acid: ionises in water to produce H⁺ ions (actually H₃O⁺). Alkali: dissolves in water to produce OH⁻ ions.
keyPoints.bm: Asid: mengion dalam air menghasilkan ion H⁺ (sebenarnya H₃O⁺). Alkali: larut dalam air menghasilkan ion OH⁻.

keyPoints.en: Without water, acids exist as molecules and show no acidic properties (dry HCl in methylbenzene).
keyPoints.bm: Tanpa air, asid wujud sebagai molekul dan tidak menunjukkan sifat asid (HCl kering dalam metilbenzena).

keyPoints.en: Similarly, ammonia shows alkaline properties only in water: NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻.
keyPoints.bm: Begitu juga ammonia hanya menunjukkan sifat alkali dalam air: NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻.

keyPoints.en: Basicity: number of H⁺ per acid molecule — monoprotic (HCl, HNO₃), diprotic (H₂SO₄), triprotic (H₃PO₄).
keyPoints.bm: Kebesan: bilangan H⁺ per molekul asid — monoprotik (HCl, HNO₃), diprotik (H₂SO₄), triprotik (H₃PO₄).

question.en: Why does citric acid powder only taste sour when wet?
question.bm: Mengapa serbuk asid sitrik hanya terasa masam apabila basah?

answer.en: Water lets it ionise and release H⁺ ions.
answer.bm: Air membolehkannya mengion dan membebaskan ion H⁺.

tip.en: All alkalis are bases, but not all bases are alkalis (CuO is a base but insoluble).
tip.bm: Semua alkali ialah bes, tetapi tidak semua bes ialah alkali (CuO ialah bes tetapi tidak larut).

keyPoints.en: pH scale 0–14: below 7 acidic, 7 neutral, above 7 alkaline.
keyPoints.bm: Skala pH 0–14: bawah 7 berasid, 7 neutral, atas 7 beralkali.

keyPoints.en: pH = −log[H⁺]; pOH = −log[OH⁻]; pH + pOH = 14.
keyPoints.bm: pH = −log[H⁺]; pOH = −log[OH⁻]; pH + pOH = 14.

keyPoints.en: Each pH unit is a 10× change in [H⁺]: pH 2 is ten times more acidic than pH 3.
keyPoints.bm: Setiap unit pH ialah perubahan 10× dalam [H⁺]: pH 2 sepuluh kali lebih berasid daripada pH 3.

keyPoints.en: Measure pH with universal indicator, pH paper or a pH meter.
keyPoints.bm: Ukur pH dengan penunjuk semesta, kertas pH atau meter pH.

question.en: Find the pH of 0.001 mol dm⁻³ NaOH.

tip.en: For alkalis, find pOH first, then subtract from 14.
tip.bm: Bagi alkali, cari pOH dahulu, kemudian tolak daripada 14.

keyPoints.en: Strong acid/alkali: ionises completely in water (HCl, H₂SO₄, HNO₃; NaOH, KOH).
keyPoints.bm: Asid/alkali kuat: mengion lengkap dalam air (HCl, H₂SO₄, HNO₃; NaOH, KOH).

keyPoints.en: Weak acid/alkali: ionises partially (ethanoic acid, citric acid; ammonia).
keyPoints.bm: Asid/alkali lemah: mengion separa (asid etanoik, asid sitrik; ammonia).

keyPoints.en: Strength ≠ concentration: a dilute strong acid can have a lower pH than a concentrated weak acid of the same molarity.
keyPoints.bm: Kekuatan ≠ kepekatan: asid kuat cair boleh mempunyai pH lebih rendah daripada asid lemah pada kemolaran sama.

keyPoints.en: At the same concentration, the strong acid has more H⁺, lower pH and reacts faster.
keyPoints.bm: Pada kepekatan yang sama, asid kuat mempunyai lebih banyak H⁺, pH lebih rendah dan bertindak balas lebih cepat.

question.en: Which has a higher pH: 0.1 mol dm⁻³ NaOH or 0.1 mol dm⁻³ NH₃?
question.bm: Yang manakah pH lebih tinggi: NaOH 0.1 mol dm⁻³ atau NH₃ 0.1 mol dm⁻³?

answer.en: NaOH — it ionises completely, so [OH⁻] is higher.
answer.bm: NaOH — ia mengion lengkap, jadi [OH⁻] lebih tinggi.

tip.en: Use 'ionises completely/partially' — examiners look for these exact words.
tip.bm: Guna 'mengion lengkap/separa' — pemeriksa mencari perkataan tepat ini.

keyPoints.en: Acid + reactive metal → salt + hydrogen (e.g. Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂).
keyPoints.bm: Asid + logam reaktif → garam + hidrogen (cth. Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂).

keyPoints.en: Acid + base (metal oxide/hydroxide) → salt + water.
keyPoints.bm: Asid + bes (oksida/hidroksida logam) → garam + air.

keyPoints.en: Acid + carbonate → salt + water + carbon dioxide.
keyPoints.bm: Asid + karbonat → garam + air + karbon dioksida.

keyPoints.en: Alkali + ammonium salt (heat) → salt + water + ammonia; alkali + metal ion solution → metal hydroxide precipitate.
keyPoints.bm: Alkali + garam ammonium (panaskan) → garam + air + ammonia; alkali + larutan ion logam → mendakan hidroksida logam.

question.en: Write the equation for sulfuric acid reacting with copper(II) oxide.
question.bm: Tulis persamaan bagi asid sulfurik bertindak balas dengan kuprum(II) oksida.

answer.en: H₂SO₄ + CuO → CuSO₄ + H₂O (black solid dissolves, blue solution)
answer.bm: H₂SO₄ + CuO → CuSO₄ + H₂O (pepejal hitam larut, larutan biru)

tip.en: Copper doesn't react with dilute acids — it's below hydrogen in reactivity.
tip.bm: Kuprum tidak bertindak balas dengan asid cair — ia di bawah hidrogen dalam siri kereaktifan.

keyPoints.en: Concentration = amount of solute per unit volume of solution.
keyPoints.bm: Kepekatan = kuantiti zat terlarut per unit isi padu larutan.

keyPoints.en: Molarity M = n/V (mol dm⁻³), where V is in dm³ (1 dm³ = 1000 cm³).
keyPoints.bm: Kemolaran M = n/V (mol dm⁻³), dengan V dalam dm³ (1 dm³ = 1000 cm³).

keyPoints.en: Concentration in g dm⁻³ = mol dm⁻³ × molar mass.
keyPoints.bm: Kepekatan dalam g dm⁻³ = mol dm⁻³ × jisim molar.

keyPoints.en: Number of moles in a solution: n = MV/1000 when V is in cm³.
keyPoints.bm: Bilangan mol dalam larutan: n = MV/1000 apabila V dalam cm³.

question.en: Convert 0.5 mol dm⁻³ NaOH to g dm⁻³. (NaOH = 40)
question.bm: Tukar NaOH 0.5 mol dm⁻³ kepada g dm⁻³. (NaOH = 40)

tip.en: Divide cm³ by 1000 before using M = n/V.
tip.bm: Bahagi cm³ dengan 1000 sebelum guna M = n/V.

keyPoints.en: A standard solution has an accurately known concentration.
keyPoints.bm: Larutan piawai mempunyai kepekatan yang diketahui dengan tepat.

keyPoints.en: Prepare: calculate mass → weigh accurately → dissolve in a beaker → transfer with rinsings into a volumetric flask → add water to the mark → stopper and invert.
keyPoints.bm: Sediakan: hitung jisim → timbang dengan tepat → larutkan dalam bikar → pindah bersama bilasan ke kelalang volumetrik → tambah air hingga tanda → sumbat dan terbalikkan.

keyPoints.en: Dilution: adding water lowers concentration but moles stay the same: M₁V₁ = M₂V₂.
keyPoints.bm: Pencairan: menambah air merendahkan kepekatan tetapi bilangan mol tetap: M₁V₁ = M₂V₂.

keyPoints.en: Use a pipette to measure the volume of the concentrated solution accurately.
keyPoints.bm: Guna pipet untuk menyukat isi padu larutan pekat dengan tepat.

question.en: How do you make 100 cm³ of 0.2 mol dm⁻³ HCl from 1.0 mol dm⁻³ HCl?
question.bm: Bagaimana menyediakan 100 cm³ HCl 0.2 mol dm⁻³ daripada HCl 1.0 mol dm⁻³?

answer.en: V₁ = 0.2 × 100 ÷ 1.0 = 20 cm³; pipette 20 cm³ into a 100 cm³ volumetric flask and top up with water.
answer.bm: V₁ = 0.2 × 100 ÷ 1.0 = 20 cm³; pipet 20 cm³ ke kelalang volumetrik 100 cm³ dan tambah air.

tip.en: Read the meniscus at eye level — the bottom of the curve should touch the mark.
tip.bm: Baca meniskus pada aras mata — bahagian bawah lengkung menyentuh tanda.

keyPoints.en: Neutralisation: acid + base → salt + water; ionic equation H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O.
keyPoints.bm: Peneutralan: asid + bes → garam + air; persamaan ion H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O.

keyPoints.en: Titration: add acid from a burette to a fixed volume of alkali (pipette) with an indicator until the end point.
keyPoints.bm: Pentitratan: tambah asid dari buret kepada isi padu alkali tetap (pipet) dengan penunjuk sehingga takat akhir.

keyPoints.en: Indicators: phenolphthalein (pink → colourless), methyl orange (yellow → orange/red).
keyPoints.bm: Penunjuk: fenolftalein (merah jambu → tidak berwarna), metil jingga (kuning → jingga/merah).

keyPoints.en: Calculate with M_aV_a / M_bV_b = a/b from the balanced equation.
keyPoints.bm: Hitung dengan M_aV_a / M_bV_b = a/b daripada persamaan seimbang.

keyPoints.en: Daily uses: antacids (Mg(OH)₂), lime (CaO) for acidic soil, toothpaste neutralising mouth acid.
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan harian: antasid (Mg(OH)₂), kapur (CaO) untuk tanah berasid, ubat gigi meneutralkan asid mulut.

question.en: 20 cm³ of 0.1 mol dm⁻³ H₂SO₄ neutralises 25 cm³ NaOH. Find M of NaOH.
question.bm: 20 cm³ H₂SO₄ 0.1 mol dm⁻³ meneutralkan 25 cm³ NaOH. Cari M NaOH.

tip.en: Always check the mole ratio — H₂SO₄ is diprotic, so a : b = 1 : 2 with NaOH.
tip.bm: Sentiasa semak nisbah mol — H₂SO₄ diprotik, jadi a : b = 1 : 2 dengan NaOH.

keyPoints.en: A salt forms when the H⁺ of an acid is replaced by a metal ion or ammonium ion.
keyPoints.bm: Garam terbentuk apabila H⁺ asid digantikan oleh ion logam atau ion ammonium.

keyPoints.en: Soluble: all Na⁺, K⁺, NH₄⁺ salts; all nitrates; most chlorides (except AgCl, PbCl₂*); most sulfates (except BaSO₄, PbSO₄, CaSO₄).
keyPoints.bm: Larut: semua garam Na⁺, K⁺, NH₄⁺; semua nitrat; kebanyakan klorida (kecuali AgCl, PbCl₂*); kebanyakan sulfat (kecuali BaSO₄, PbSO₄, CaSO₄).

keyPoints.en: Carbonates are insoluble except Na₂CO₃, K₂CO₃ and (NH₄)₂CO₃. *PbCl₂ dissolves in hot water.
keyPoints.bm: Karbonat tidak larut kecuali Na₂CO₃, K₂CO₃ dan (NH₄)₂CO₃. *PbCl₂ larut dalam air panas.

keyPoints.en: Crystals have regular shapes, flat faces and straight edges. Uses: NaCl (food), CaSO₄ (plaster), NH₄NO₃ (fertiliser).
keyPoints.bm: Hablur mempunyai bentuk tetap, permukaan rata dan sisi lurus. Kegunaan: NaCl (makanan), CaSO₄ (plaster), NH₄NO₃ (baja).

question.en: Is lead(II) nitrate soluble in water?
question.bm: Adakah plumbum(II) nitrat larut dalam air?

tip.en: Memorise the solubility rules — you need them to choose the salt preparation method.
tip.bm: Hafal peraturan keterlarutan — diperlukan untuk memilih kaedah penyediaan garam.

keyPoints.en: Soluble Na/K/NH₄ salts: titration (acid + alkali), then evaporate and crystallise.
keyPoints.bm: Garam larut Na/K/NH₄: pentitratan (asid + alkali), kemudian sejat dan hablurkan.

keyPoints.en: Other soluble salts: add excess metal oxide/carbonate/metal to acid, filter off the excess, heat filtrate to saturation, cool to crystallise.
keyPoints.bm: Garam larut lain: tambah oksida/karbonat/logam berlebihan ke dalam asid, turas lebihan, panaskan hasil turasan hingga tepu, sejukkan untuk menghablur.

keyPoints.en: Insoluble salts: precipitation (double decomposition) — mix two solutions, filter, rinse with distilled water, dry.
keyPoints.bm: Garam tidak larut: pemendakan (penguraian ganda dua) — campur dua larutan, turas, bilas dengan air suling, keringkan.

keyPoints.en: Purify crystals by recrystallisation.
keyPoints.bm: Tulenkan hablur melalui penghabluran semula.

question.en: Plan how to prepare dry copper(II) sulfate crystals.
question.bm: Rancang cara menyediakan hablur kuprum(II) sulfat yang kering.

answer.en: Add excess CuO to warm dilute H₂SO₄, filter, heat filtrate until saturated, cool, filter crystals and dry between filter papers.
answer.bm: Tambah CuO berlebihan ke dalam H₂SO₄ cair suam, turas, panaskan hasil turasan hingga tepu, sejukkan, turas hablur dan keringkan di antara kertas turas.

tip.en: Don't heat crystals to dryness — they lose water of crystallisation.
tip.bm: Jangan panaskan hablur hingga kering — ia kehilangan air penghabluran.

keyPoints.en: Carbonates decompose to metal oxide + CO₂ (except Na₂CO₃, K₂CO₃).
keyPoints.bm: Karbonat terurai kepada oksida logam + CO₂ (kecuali Na₂CO₃, K₂CO₃).

keyPoints.en: Nitrates decompose to metal oxide + NO₂ (brown gas) + O₂; Na/K nitrates give nitrite + O₂ only.
keyPoints.bm: Nitrat terurai kepada oksida logam + NO₂ (gas perang) + O₂; nitrat Na/K memberi nitrit + O₂ sahaja.

keyPoints.en: Residue colours: ZnO yellow when hot, white when cold; PbO brown hot, yellow cold; CuO black.
keyPoints.bm: Warna baki: ZnO kuning ketika panas, putih ketika sejuk; PbO perang panas, kuning sejuk; CuO hitam.

keyPoints.en: Most sulfates and chlorides don't decompose easily on heating (NH₄Cl sublimes).
keyPoints.bm: Kebanyakan sulfat dan klorida tidak mudah terurai apabila dipanaskan (NH₄Cl memejalwap).

question.en: Write the equation for heating zinc carbonate.

answer.en: ZnCO₃ → ZnO + CO₂ (white → yellow when hot → white when cold)
answer.bm: ZnCO₃ → ZnO + CO₂ (putih → kuning ketika panas → putih ketika sejuk)

tip.en: The colour of the residue when hot and cold is a key clue to identify the cation.
tip.bm: Warna baki ketika panas dan sejuk ialah petunjuk utama untuk mengenal pasti kation.

keyPoints.en: Gas tests: H₂ (pop), O₂ (relights glowing splinter), CO₂ (limewater chalky), NH₃ (damp red litmus → blue), Cl₂ (bleaches damp litmus), NO₂ (brown, damp blue litmus → red).
keyPoints.bm: Ujian gas: H₂ ('pop'), O₂ (nyalakan kayu uji berbara), CO₂ (air kapur keruh), NH₃ (litmus merah lembap → biru), Cl₂ (lunturkan litmus lembap), NO₂ (perang, litmus biru lembap → merah).

keyPoints.en: Anion tests: Cl⁻ (HNO₃ + AgNO₃ → white ppt), SO₄²⁻ (HCl + BaCl₂ → white ppt), CO₃²⁻ (acid → CO₂), NO₃⁻ (brown ring with FeSO₄ + conc. H₂SO₄).
keyPoints.bm: Ujian anion: Cl⁻ (HNO₃ + AgNO₃ → mendakan putih), SO₄²⁻ (HCl + BaCl₂ → mendakan putih), CO₃²⁻ (asid → CO₂), NO₃⁻ (cincin perang dengan FeSO₄ + H₂SO₄ pekat).

keyPoints.en: Cations with NaOH(aq): Cu²⁺ blue ppt; Fe²⁺ green; Fe³⁺ brown; Zn²⁺, Al³⁺, Pb²⁺ white ppt soluble in excess; Mg²⁺, Ca²⁺ white insoluble.
keyPoints.bm: Kation dengan NaOH(ak): Cu²⁺ mendakan biru; Fe²⁺ hijau; Fe³⁺ perang; Zn²⁺, Al³⁺, Pb²⁺ mendakan putih larut dalam berlebihan; Mg²⁺, Ca²⁺ putih tidak larut.

keyPoints.en: With NH₃(aq): Zn²⁺ white ppt dissolves in excess; Cu²⁺ blue ppt dissolves to a dark blue solution.
keyPoints.bm: Dengan NH₃(ak): Zn²⁺ mendakan putih larut dalam berlebihan; Cu²⁺ mendakan biru larut membentuk larutan biru tua.

keyPoints.en: Confirmatory: Fe²⁺ (K₃Fe(CN)₆ → dark blue), Fe³⁺ (KSCN → blood red), Pb²⁺ (KI → yellow ppt), NH₄⁺ (Nessler's → brown).
keyPoints.bm: Pengesahan: Fe²⁺ (K₃Fe(CN)₆ → biru tua), Fe³⁺ (KSCN → merah darah), Pb²⁺ (KI → mendakan kuning), NH₄⁺ (Nessler → perang).

question.en: A solution gives a white precipitate with both NaOH and NH₃, soluble in excess of both. Identify the cation.
question.bm: Larutan memberi mendakan putih dengan NaOH dan NH₃, larut dalam kedua-duanya berlebihan. Kenal pasti kation.

answer.en: Zn²⁺ — the only one soluble in excess of both.
answer.bm: Zn²⁺ — satu-satunya yang larut dalam kedua-duanya berlebihan.

tip.en: Make a table of cation results with NaOH and NH₃ — it solves most qualitative analysis questions.
tip.bm: Buat jadual keputusan kation dengan NaOH dan NH₃ — ia menyelesaikan kebanyakan soalan analisis kualitatif.
